page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek words in the paragraph beginning "Sanctæ vitæ" (εὐσεβῶς, δικαίως, σωφρόνως) and "ἡ ἐπιμέλεια", "πάντα δυνατά" and "Φιλοπονία" are copied from the scan but should be checked against the original. "Itaq[?]" has an unclear abbreviation mark after the q. The line-end hyphen in "ne-cessum" and "scriban-tur" is printed. The ornament bands are not text and are left out. The signature "Ec 2" is at the foot.
